transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I just can’t keep my mind on one thing anymore. At work, one saw starts up, or somebody walks past, or I think of another job for a second, and I’m off track. Then the whole day kind of gets away from me.
When you were a child, were you also easily distracted?

Yeah… I think so. In grade school, before I was 12, teachers would tell my mom I was smart but careless. I’d lose homework, forget what I was supposed to do, or just be staring out the window instead of finishing my work.
Do you have the same trouble focusing when you’re not at work, like at home?
Yeah… it’s not just work. At home it’s kind of the same. Something small pulls me off—noise, someone walking by, even just another thought—and then I’m not doing what I meant to be doing anymore.
Do you often feel restless, like you have trouble sitting still?

Yeah… especially if I’m stuck at a desk doing estimates, or in a long meeting. I get kind of wound up inside, like I need to get up and move around, even when I know I’m supposed to just sit there and finish.
Have these concentration problems caused real trouble for you at work?

Yeah… it has. I don’t really like saying that, but I’ve lost commissions from mistakes or being late with things. Sometimes jobs have had to be redone because I missed something. And the crew doesn’t really trust me much with scheduling or ordering anymore.
Have these focus problems caused real trouble for you at home?
Yeah… it has. I mean, my husband’s had to take over the bills and a lot of the reminders, because I’ll misplace papers or just… miss what needs doing. I don’t like that, but it’s been a problem.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about many different things?
I don’t know… not really in that way. I mean, I worry about things when they’re right in front of me, but I wouldn’t say I sit around worrying about everything all the time.
Do you often lose things you need for work or daily life?

Yeah… pretty often. I’m always looking for my keys, my tape measure, my phone… order sheets. Even notes I swear I just had in my hand. It wastes a lot of time, and the guys have started kind of checking behind me.
